requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-1486-4231-4875--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1445-4871-7272-8347.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7272-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3196-3518-3668-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying {U}{U}, causing it to enter with vanishing 3 as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Last Voyage of the ______ by paying {3}{B}.
When Last Voyage of the ______ enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the ______ attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1477-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-5933--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Popular Egotist ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

465-585-1251-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

851-2557-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1643-2073-2511-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

443-2946-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2946-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1753-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-1753-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-3742-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6143.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Feywild Caretaker to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

147-2034-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2034-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3698-6972-7157.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Lancer enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2792-3647-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-4823.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Great Whale
When Timeless Witness and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-4823.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

2232-3455-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-3455-6749.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Vizier of Many Faces from the battlefield to your hand.
When Vizier of Many Faces leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Vizier of Many Faces from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2034-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2440-2534-5663--108.notablePrerequisites: You control a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.
2440-2534-5663--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Coercive Recruiter token.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Coercive Recruiter token.
Repeat.
2440-2534-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.

372-1309-3556.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker.
372-1309-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2921-4231-4321-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Astrid, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

20-1775-2488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls at least one creature.
You control at least two Foods.
20-1775-2488.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gyome twice by paying {2} and sacrificing two Foods, giving Apex Altisaur and any creature an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing Apex Altisaur to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Apex Altisaur's second ability triggers, and Toralf triggers if the opposing creature's toughness is less than 0.
Resolve the Toralf trigger, if applicable, dealing damage equal to the excess to any target.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

344-3489-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Skullsnatcher does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
344-3489-3821.description:
Declare Skullsnatcher as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Peregrine Drake's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Skullsnatcher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Peregrine Drake onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

933-1418-1558-4231-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

222-1385-4050-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding {R}.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee to the battlefield from your graveyard and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Junji to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2397-3657-4022.description:
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hidden Herbalists to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}.
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1379-1651-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Treasure tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Construct tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

3062-3569-4577-5256.notablePrerequisites: At least three reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
3062-3569-4577-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Pollenbright Druid.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, causing you to remove two counters from it and return Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield, proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing any player to mill a card.
Repeat.

553-3634.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Venser enters the battlefield, returning Approach of the Second Sun to your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

3628-4447-5299.notablePrerequisites: Assault Suit attached to Lunar Force.
3628-4447-5299.description: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, Lunar Force triggers, countering the spell and causing you to not sacrifice Lunar Force due to Assault Suit.

3554-4079-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Scheming Symmetry and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Scheming Symmetry by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.

1330-2484-2615.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana available to cast Blasphemous Act.
1330-2484-2615.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing thirteen damage to all creatures.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing thirteen damage to target opponent.
